name: binto-operations
description: Read your Binto Operations records from your assistant: what needs attention, documents and permits, equipment service history, contacts, procedures, inspections and tasks. Read-only.

interface.longDescription:
Binto Operations lets you ask about your business records in Binto without leaving the conversation. Ask what needs attention across your Locations, find a license, permit, lease or insurance document by a Location's name or address and see when it expires, look up when a piece of equipment was last serviced, what was done and what it cost, find a supplier or service provider's contact details, read a procedure or an inspection report, and review open and overdue tasks.

It is for owners, managers and team members of businesses that keep their Locations' records in Binto Operations. You sign in to Binto and approve the connection. The assistant then sees only the Organizations, Locations and records your own Binto account can open, and answers cite the records they came from with links back to Binto.

Limitations: Binto Operations is read-only. It cannot add, change, delete, send or pay for anything in Binto. It needs a Binto account that belongs to an Organization with Ask Binto turned on. Account numbers, logins and passwords saved on contacts are never returned.
capabilities: See what needs attention across Locations
defaultPrompt: What needs attention across my Locations this week?
Find the health permit for my Main Street Location. When does it expire?
When was the walk-in cooler last serviced, and what did it cost?

positive.description: Equipment service history at a Location, by name
positive.prompt: When was the walk-in cooler at Maple Street Market last serviced, what was done and what did it cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Walk-in Cooler at Maple Street Market and reports its most recent service record: October 16, 2026, preventive maintenance (coils cleaned, door gasket adjusted, drain and defrost checked, recorded temperature 36 F), cost $350.00, citing the Maple Street Market Cooler Service Report with a link to Binto. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Find a license at a Location and read its expiration date
positive.prompt: When does the business license for Maple Street Market expire?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the document Maple Street Market Business License and states its expiration date of June 30, 2027 exactly as recorded, with a link to the document in Binto. It does not invent a license number.

positive.description: Find a lease and its term
positive.prompt: Find the lease for Maple Street Market and tell me when it starts and ends.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the document maple-street-market-commercial-lease with its effective date of April 1, 2025 and its expiration date of December 31, 2026, citing the document with a link.

positive.description: Find a service provider's contact details
positive.prompt: Who do we call for refrigeration service at Maple Street Market, and what is their phone number?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the contact Summit Refrigeration with Taylor Reed as the primary person and the phone number (913) 555-0120. No account number, login or password is shown.

positive.description: Review open tasks at a Location
positive.prompt: What open tasks do we have at Maple Street Market, and when are they due?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the five open (To Do) tasks at Maple Street Market, Test Task 1 to Test Task 5, each with its due date and priority, marking any that are overdue on the day of review. Nothing is changed.

negative.description: A request to change data. The plugin is read-only and has no write tools, so the assistant should explain it cannot delete anything and change nothing.
negative.prompt: Delete the insurance policy for Maple Street Market.

negative.description: A question outside the person's business records. The assistant should not use Binto tools for it, or should say Binto only has their Operations records.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Kansas City tomorrow?

negative.description: A Location this account cannot access. The assistant should find no Location it can open, return no documents, and not reveal whether that Location exists.
negative.prompt: Show me the documents for the Location at 7510 E 87th St.

review.commerce_description: Binto Operations does not sell products, take payments or show plans. It only reads the signed-in person's Operations records.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Read-only access to Binto Operations records: what needs attention, documents and permits, equipment service history, contacts, procedures, inspection reports and tasks.
